Minimal multi-feature happy path across functio, fixum, si, and nota.

# =============================================================================
# integratio — Minimal multi-feature happy path across functio, fixum, si, and nota
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Minimal multi-feature happy path across functio, fixum, si, and nota.
#   • Related keywords: functio, fixum, si, nota
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Writing code outside `incipit` that produces side effects — top-level code runs at module load; prefer `incipit` for program entry.
#
# See also: functio, fixum, si, nota
# =============================================================================

# integratio — minimal multi-feature happy path
#
# functio name(params) → type { … }
# fixum _ n ← expr
# si <cond> { … }
# nota template with § interpolation
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   funcDecl   :← 'functio' ident '(' params ')' ('→' type)? block
#   condStmt   :← 'si' expr block
#   outputStmt :← 'nota' expr
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   minimum-smoke.expected — par 42 when n is even.

fn par(int n) → bool {
    return n % 2 ≡ 0
}

main {
    const _ n ← 42
    if par(n) {
        print "par §"(n)
    }
}

Expected output:

par 42
